title: Abraham Describes His Lord and Prays for Mercy

paragraphs.text: Abraham told his people that the idols worshipped by them and their ancient forefathers were his enemies. He would have nothing to do with them. Only the Lord of the worlds was different. Abraham then described his Lord with love. He is the One who created him and guides him. He gives him food and drink. When he is sick, it is Allah who heals him. Allah will cause him to die and then bring him back to life. Abraham hoped that Allah would forgive his sins on the Day of Judgment.

Then Abraham made a beautiful prayer. He asked his Lord to give him wisdom and to join him with the righteous. He asked for an honored name among the people who would come after him. He asked to be one of those who inherit the Garden of Pleasure. He asked Allah to forgive his father, because his father had gone astray. He also asked not to be put to shame on the Day when all people are raised.

On that Day, wealth and children will not help anyone. Only a person who comes to Allah with a sound and pure heart will be saved. Paradise will be brought close to the righteous. Hellfire will be shown clearly to those who went astray. Then they will be asked, "Where are the things you used to worship?"

hardWords.m: a painful feeling after doing wrong
